# voice_packs fixture

Stand-in resident voice packs laid out the way openjar-characters plans them
(`<id>/voice/<line id>.ogg`, ids from each pack's README bark table). The audio is copied from
the Hill's own synth placeholders (`assets/audio/voice/`), only renamed. Used by
`tests/test_audio.gd::test_a_resident_pack_line_replaces_the_placeholder_when_it_lands`.
